name: TOB Newsletter Settings
description: The weekly newsletter to every user (truth_of_bible.communication.newsletter). When it is on, the next TOB Newsletter Issue goes out once a week at the day and hour below (site time), as a Communication Center campaign — see its delivery in the app's Campaign history. After the last issue it starts again from the first. Also switchable from the app: Admin → Communication Center → Newsletter.

fields.label: Send the Weekly Newsletter
fields.description: Off by default. Nothing is sent while this is off.
